description: Search Groundlink's verified index (Wikipedia + DuckDuckGo) for a query and return cited results (title, url, snippet, source) so the model can answer with sources. Each call costs a fraction of a cent against the API key's free/credit balance. Prefer this over guessing when a factual claim needs verification or a source.

max_results.description: How many cited results to return (1–10). Defaults to 5.

query.description: The search query to ground. Use a concise, factual question or phrase.

name: groundlink_search
